entries.good_example:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail
# -E: ERR trap is inherited by functions
# -e: Exit on error
# -u: Error on unset variables
# -o pipefail: Error if any pipe command fails
entries.rationale: Standard bash headers fail silently. The SS QLM standard enforces early termination and strict variable checking.
Missing quotes lead to word splitting and globbing, causing catastrophic data loss if paths contain spaces.
Global state contamination is the #1 cause of bugs in complex scripts. Always use 'local' or 'declare'.
